Final results of the [[tennis]] competition at the [[1924 Summer Olympics]] in [[Paris]], France. After the 1924 Olympics, the tennis competition would be dropped until 1988. The mixed doubles competition did not return until the 2012 Olympics.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/games/8/sports/TEN |title=Tennis at the 1924 Summer Olympics |work=Olympedia |access-date=11 July 2020}}</ref>
